item.title: Ask HN: How can I improve my products? Which one to keep working on?
item.summary: I am looking for feedback on my products and I am interested in knowing how to find out which one to keep working on? Here is the list - https://www.blanketstories.com/ Bedtime stories. https://my-morning-report.vercel.app Single Report from all tools like Gmail, Slack, Todo tools, Github, Hubspot etc. https://agentic-teaching.vercel.app - Learning Posts by Agents. https://usepostly.in - FB and Insta Automation.
